summary: Master customer onboarding and adoption management with journey maps, health scores, and action plans. Build practical tools and improve retention.
lede: Customer onboarding and adoption management provides a structured way to guide customers from purchase to first value, sustained usage, and measurable adoption. This course shows you how to create repeatable onboarding journeys, set activation milestones, coordinate stakeholder handoffs, and monitor customer health signals. You will practise customer journey mapping, onboarding checklists, adoption scorecards, stakeholder alignment maps, and 90-day action plans. The course also covers enablement touchpoints, adoption reporting, and practical ways to reduce friction across sales, implementation, support, product, and customer success teams.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for customer-facing professionals who manage onboarding, adoption, and early lifecycle success across B2B customer accounts.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and standard presentation tools for mapping and reporting exercises. A willingness to work with customer success scenarios, usage metrics, and onboarding templates will help you get the most from the course.
